control.title: Approved Scanning Vendor and internal vulnerability scans
control.description: Run internal vulnerability scans and external scans by a PCI SSC Approved Scanning Vendor at least once every three months and after significant changes, and rescan until passing.

evidence_hint: Four quarters of passing ASV scan reports and internal scan reports.
acceptance_criteria: Passing external ASV scan reports for each quarter
Internal scan reports with high findings remediated

criteria_coverage.criterion: Passing external ASV scan reports for each quarter
Internal scan reports with high findings remediated

requirements.title: Internal audits, external audit, half-yearly VAPT and PCI reports
requirements.guidance: Quarterly internal and annual external audit reports to the IT committee, half-yearly VAPT, and PCI DSS AOC or ROC.
